Metadata.Goal: Add attractor profiles and explicit plan XML attractor-check hooks that can validate track design, phases, tasks, and archive readiness against selected attractor bundles.
Metadata.Description: Add attractor profiles and explicit plan XML attractor-check hooks that can validate track design, phases, tasks, and archive readiness against selected attractor bundles.

TaskSpace.name: add-attractor-check-hooks
TaskSpace.Description: Add attractor profiles and explicit plan XML attractor-check hooks that can validate track design, phases, tasks, and archive readiness against selected attractor bundles.

TaskGroup.name: Spec and protocol definition
TaskGroup.Description: Define the attractor profile and attractor-check hook contract in specifications and standard protocol documents.

Task.name: Update codument-core spec registry
Task.Description: Apply the spec delta for attractor profile configuration, attractor-check hook behavior, result policy, and workflow integration.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: `codument-core` contains requirements for attractor profiles and attractor-check hooks
Scenarios cover default profile fallback, configured profiles, lifecycle-specific profiles, result policies, and no-hook behavior

Task.name: Document plan XML node shape
Task.Description: Update plan XML documentation to define `<attractor-check>` placement, attributes, status values, ordering, and relationship to `<confirm>`.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: `plan-xml-spec.md` documents `<attractor-check>`
Examples show default and docs profiles
Nested `<confirm>` under result policy is documented

Task.name: Define attractor check protocol
Task.Description: Update protocols documentation to describe executor behavior, structured result status, result policy handling, and parent orchestration rules.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Protocol defines PASS/GAP/BLOCKED structured result
Protocol defines fix-immediately, confirm-before-fix, and block behaviors
Protocol prevents competing nested attractor checks when an upper layer owns the hook

Task.name: Define operation-hooks.xml overlay
Task.Description: Document `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` as a sparse workspace-level XML hook overlay for Codument operations that do not have their own `plan.xml` execution plan.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Spec defines operation hook overlay behavior
Overlay is sparse and does not require predefining every Codument command
Overlay reuses `<attractor-check>`, `<result-policy>`, and `<confirm>` semantics

Task.name: Define revise-track command
Task.Description: Define `revise-track` as the explicit command or skill for amending existing track artifacts during implementation, gap-loop, archive preparation, or other non-linear Codument work.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Spec defines `revise-track` inputs and behavior
Spec requires revisions to stay inside the target track directory
Spec defines interaction with operation hooks and attractor profiles

TaskGroup.name: Config and validation support
TaskGroup.Description: Add workspace configuration and validation support for attractor profiles and plan hooks.

Task.name: Add attractor profile config helpers
Task.Description: Implement or update config helpers to resolve `codument/config/attractor-profiles.json` with an implicit default profile fallback.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Missing profile config resolves default project/product attractors
Configured profiles resolve custom attractor lists
Missing referenced profiles or files produce clear errors

Task.name: Update init and upgrade behavior
Task.Description: Create or preserve attractor profile config during init and upgrade without overwriting user edits.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: New init creates or documents default attractor profile config
Upgrade creates missing config safely
Existing user profile config is not overwritten

Task.name: Validate attractor-check nodes
Task.Description: Extend validation to check `<attractor-check>` attributes, supported result policies, and profile references where practical.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Invalid `when`, `status`, `executor`, or `on-gap` values are reported
Missing profile references are reported
Valid nested `<confirm>` remains accepted

Task.name: Validate operation-hooks.xml
Task.Description: Add validation for `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` shape, operation names, known hook points, nested hook DSL, and profile references.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Missing overlay file keeps existing behavior valid
Known operation hook points are validated when available
Nested attractor-check and confirm nodes are validated consistently

TaskGroup.name: Workflow and prompt integration
TaskGroup.Description: Teach Codument lifecycle prompts and generated skills to create and execute attractor-check hooks.

Task.name: Update track creation prompts
Task.Description: Update track creation guidance so plan generation can insert design, phase, task, or archive attractor checks with selected profiles.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Track prompt explains attractor profiles
Track prompt can generate `<attractor-check>` examples
Default behavior stays lightweight and does not force checks everywhere

Task.name: Update implementation and wave execution prompts
Task.Description: Update implement and execute-wave flows to run attractor-check hooks at configured before/after/both points and apply result policies.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Phase-level and task-level hooks are handled
No hook means no implicit wait or check
Nested confirm policy is delegated to existing confirm protocol

Task.name: Update gap-loop and archive prompts
Task.Description: Clarify how gap-loop interacts with attractor-check results and how archive can run docs or archive-readiness profiles.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Gap-loop avoids competing nested hook ownership
Archive prompt can run docs-related attractor profile checks before archive completion
Knowledge sync guidance can use profile-specific attractors

Task.name: Update operation hook execution guidance
Task.Description: Update Codument command and skill prompts to read `codument/config/operation-hooks.xml` entries and execute only configured hook points.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Track command can execute configured after-design or after-plan hooks
Archive command can execute configured before-archive or docs-readiness hooks
Commands without overlay entries keep default behavior

Task.name: Add revise-track command and skill
Task.Description: Add `revise-track` prompt, generated skill support, and optional CLI command behavior for revising existing track artifacts.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: `revise-track` can resolve and read a target track
`revise-track` can update proposal, design, spec deltas, plan, analysis, or decisions as needed
`revise-track` executes configured before-revise hooks before file changes

Task.name: Regenerate lifecycle skills
Task.Description: Ensure generated Codument lifecycle skills include updated attractor-check guidance.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Generated skills mention attractor profiles where relevant
Generated skills mention `<attractor-check>` execution semantics where relevant
Generated skills mention `operation-hooks.xml` semantics where relevant
Generated skills include `revise-track` when target supports generated skills

TaskGroup.name: Tests and validation
TaskGroup.Description: Add tests and run validation for the new attractor profile and hook behavior.

Task.name: Add CLI and prompt tests
Task.Description: Add focused tests for profile config creation/resolution, plan validation, prompt content, and generated skill output.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover default profile fallback
Tests cover custom profile preservation
Tests cover invalid hook and nested confirm validation
Tests cover `operation-hooks.xml` parsing and validation
Tests cover `revise-track` prompt or command behavior

Task.name: Run project validation
Task.Description: Run relevant test and validation commands and record any skipped commands with reasons.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Relevant automated tests pass
`codument validate add-attractor-check-hooks --strict` or equivalent passes
Any unavailable validation command is explicitly reported

Task.name: Review migration and docs impact
Task.Description: Review compatibility with existing workspaces, old plans without hooks, and feature config behavior.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Existing workspaces without profile config remain valid
Existing plans without hooks do not gain implicit waits
Docs mention migration and fallback behavior
